tasks.gr11-ml-exchange-rates-t4: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 4 — Finance: Exchange Rates. Ask learners to convert between South African rand (ZAR) and foreign currencies using a given exchange rate, distinguish between buying and selling rates offered by banks, calculate the cost of foreign goods or travel in rands, interpret the impact of a weaker or stronger rand on import and export prices, and compare travel budget options in different currencies. Use realistic exchange-rate tables.
tasks.gr11-ml-data-handling-t4: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 4 — Data Handling. Ask learners to organise data in frequency tables, read and interpret bar graphs, pie charts, line graphs and histograms, calculate mean, median, mode and range for a data set, identify the most appropriate graph type for a given data set, critique graphs for misleading features (e.g. truncated axes), and write a short evidence-based conclusion from given data. Use South African social statistics or school-based contexts.
tasks.gr11-ml-exam-integration-t4: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 4 — Revision and Exam Integration. Ask integrated questions across all Grade 11 topics: finance (exchange rates, interest, taxation, budgets), measurement (conversions, perimeter, area, volume), maps and plans (scale, floor plans), data handling (graphs, averages) and probability. Questions should reflect end-of-year examination style with extended multi-step problems, reading documents or graphs, and writing justifications.
